chapters.title: 先验是更新之前的分布
chapters.en: A prior describes uncertainty before these observations.

chapters.title: 每个新观测，贡献一个似然因子
chapters.en: Each observation contributes a likelihood factor.

chapters.title: 相乘后，再归一化成新的分布
chapters.en: Multiply prior and likelihood, then normalize.

chapters.title: 后验，仍然表达不确定性
chapters.en: Updating changes uncertainty; it does not eliminate it.
